title: Get Bestselling Products
label: TIKTOK SHOP · API REFERENCE
subtitle: Updated 2026-10-13
html:
Path: /analytics/202511/products/bestselling

Method: [GET]

Function Description

Returns up to 100 products ranked by GMV for the target date range.

Common Parameters

For common parameters, refer to How to call TikTok Shop APIs - Common Parameters

Properties Location Type Require Sample Properties description
shop_cipher query string Y GCP_XF90igAAAABh00qsWgtvOiGFNqyubMt3 Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response.
Get by API Get Authorization Shop
content-type header string Y application/json Allowed type: application/json

Request Query Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
app_key string Y 38abcd Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.
sign string Y 5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.
timestamp int Y 1623812664 Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.
category_id string N 12334 Filter products by a Level 1 category ID.
date string Y 2025-11-13 The inclusive end date of the query period, in ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format and the shop's registered time zone. The period spans the selected time_slot and ends on this date (for example, 7D queries the seven days ending on this date). The date must be on or before the latest available date. If a request uses a later date, the error response identifies the latest available date; retry with that date or an earlier date.
time_slot string Y 7D The length of the query period ending on date. Supported values are:
  • 1D — 1 day
  • 7D — 7 days
  • 30D — 30 days | currency |string |N |USD |Currency for monetary values. Use USD for US dollars or LOCAL for the local currency where the shop is registered. Default: LOCAL. |

Request Sample

Query

https://open-api.tiktokglobalshop.com/analytics/202511/products/bestselling?app_key=123abc&sign=5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c&timestamp=1625484268&shop_cipher=ROW_RHkDDABBAAB8tKAVoAqsMTjsQZFLyNfY&category_id=12334&date=2025-11-13&time_slot=7D&currency=USD

Response Parameters

Properties Type Sample Properties description
code int 0 The success or failure status code returned in API response.
message string Success The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.
request_id string 202203070749000101890810281E8C70B7 Request log
data object Specific return information
^products []object List of bestselling product records for the target date range.
^^rank int 1 GMV rank of the product.
^^gmv_range string $97000.00~$191000.00 GMV range of the product, in the currency specified by currency.
^^id string 123456 Product ID
^^name string Labubu Product name
^^rating string 4.5 Product rating in history
^^product_image object Product image information, including URI, URLs, thumbnail URLs, height, and width.
^^^height int 2000 The image height.
Unit: px
^^^width int 2000 The image width.
Unit: px
^^^thumb_urls []string ["tos-useast5-i-omjb5zjo8w-tx/cad4b7c7409f459a87c54baf31ff8a20"] The URLs to view the image thumbnails.
^^^uri string tos-useast5-i-omjb5zjo8w-tx/cad4b7c7409f459a87c54baf31ff8a20 The URI of the image.
^^^urls []string ["https://p16-oec-va.ibyteimg.com/tos-maliva-i-o3syd03w52-us/157d5bf9ac5a4af5855a2284626605c8~tplv-o3syd03w52-origin-jpeg.jpeg"] The URLs to view the images.
^^shop_name string Nia Batik The TikTok Shop name.
^^shop_id string 7028916274713380866 The ID of the TikTok Shop associated with the product.
